item.title: Ina Energy plans 80 MW solar expansion as CPPA sales lift revenue mix
item.summary: Ina Energy said it plans to add 80MW of new solar grid capacity over the next two to three years as corporate power purchase agreements (CPPAs) become a larger part of its business. The Taiwanese renewable energy developer said the long-term contracts have helped build steadier cash flow as it continues to develop solar and solar-plus-storage projects.
